algorithm: 1. Extract: mode (cover vs interior page), medium/style, genre, age group, text strings, size/print target, speed vs quality.
2. mode: words 'page/interior/inside/pages to colour' => interior; 'cover/title/series/publisher' or any text request => cover. Interior profiles never contain text.
3. Style beats genre: explicit medium (watercolor, oil, pencil, anime, photo) selects that profile; genre/age then tunes prompt and negatives.
4. Score each profile: +3 style keyword, +2 genre match, +2 age match, +1 mode hint; pick highest, list runner-up.
5. Apply age_modifiers to prompt and negative; keep within profile.tuning_ranges.
6. If user wants speed/preview => draft tier; if print/final => final tier incl. upscaler; if low memory => draft dims, no upscaler.
7. Emit command from example_command_final with user's text substituted; run validation.pre_run.
tie_breakers: prefer profile with matching age group
prefer cover over interior if text requested

conflicts.then: use kids_coloring_cover or adult_coloring_cover; interior pages separately
use kids_storybook_6_8 and warn photoreal is unusual for ages <9
use adult_coloring_line_art with anime subject in prompt

conflicts.if: more than 3 text elements or title>6 words
conflicts.then: shorten or move extra text to layout software

conflicts.if: real brand, character, person or living-artist style requested
conflicts.then: decline that element; substitute original description

ask_user_only_when: no title/series/publisher text given for a cover
print size unknown and user wants print-ready

validation_global.ocr: If tesseract is available: compare recognised text to requested strings (case-insensitive, edit distance <=1 per string).
validation_global.line_art_check: Convert to grayscale; require mean>=235 and mid-gray fraction (30-220) <=8%.
validation_global.iteration_policy: Up to 3 retries: new seed -> alt sampler -> steps+6/cfg-0.5 (text) or cfg+0.5 (line art).
